options.label: Automatic (4 px cells, 8 on an ESP32)

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.description: The Doom fire, simulated a byte per cell in JS and written into the frame with frameos.pixels.

fields.name: pixelSize
fields.label: Pixel size
fields.hint: Each cell of the fire is a square this many pixels wide. Smaller is finer and slower: a 480x480 panel at 4 is a 120x120 fire. 0 picks for the device: 4, or 8 on an ESP32, where the simulation runs slower.

fields.name: stepsPerRender
fields.label: Steps per render
fields.hint: 1 on an LCD that animates. On e-paper, 60 or so, so every refresh is a new flame.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: 0 for a different fire every time; any other number for the same one.

fields.name: showFps
fields.label: FPS counter
fields.hint: Draws the frame rate in a corner: renders a second, as the panel gets them, and the size of the fire.

{
  "name": "Hellfire",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "The Doom fire, simulated a byte per cell in JS and written into the frame with frameos.pixels.",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "pixelSize", "type": "integer", "value": "0", "required": true, "label": "Pixel size", "hint": "Each cell of the fire is a square this many pixels wide. Smaller is finer and slower: a 480x480 panel at 4 is a 120x120 fire. 0 picks for the device: 4, or 8 on an ESP32, where the simulation runs slower." },
    { "name": "palette", "type": "select", "options": ["fire", "ice", "toxic"], "value": "fire", "required": true, "label": "Palette" },
    { "name": "wind", "type": "integer", "value": "1", "required": true, "label": "Wind", "hint": "-3 to 3. 1 is Doom's own drift." },
    { "name": "stepsPerRender", "type": "integer", "value": "1", "required": true, "label": "Steps per render", "hint": "1 on an LCD that animates. On e-paper, 60 or so, so every refresh is a new flame." },
    { "name": "seed", "type": "integer", "value": "0", "label": "Seed", "hint": "0 for a different fire every time; any other number for the same one." },
    { "name": "showFps", "type": "boolean", "value": "false", "label": "FPS counter", "hint": "Draws the frame rate in a corner: renders a second, as the panel gets them, and the size of the fire." }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }],
  "permissions": []
}
